I flagged `ConnPlanner.md:69-70`’s unconditional “navigates” claim: the submission algorithm can return before planning navigation.

Confidence is high for the cited standard semantics. The actual round21 invocation paths, fixture validity, and observed outcomes remain runtime-evidence questions. No corpus rows were added.
